files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- **Optional detection and batch deletion of empty folders after duplicate cleanup** ([#231](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/issues/231), PR [#233](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/pull/233)). Added `EmptyFolderCleanupService` and `/api/empty-folders/scan` + `/api/empty-folders/delete` endpoints to detect directories left completely empty (or containing only empty subdirectories) after duplicate removal, with an opt-in checkbox and dedicated `Scan empty folders` action in `Bulk Delete`, plus an `Empty Folders` button and cleanup modal in the main topbar (`Check cleaned locations` or `Scan all folders`); strictly preserves the user root `/`, configured `Origin Folders`, `Excluded Folders`, shared/external mounts, and non-deletable directories, and deletes selected folders deepest-first
- **Read-only CLI command `occ duplicates:list-folders` to report identical folder trees** ([#193](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/issues/193), PR [#229](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/pull/229)). Added `FolderDuplicateService` and `duplicates:list-folders` (`--user`, `--min-size`, `--min-files`, `--limit`, `--output=table|json`) to identify directories whose recursive relative file paths, content hashes, and total sizes match 100%, collapsing identical subdirectories already covered by an identical parent folder pair

### Fixed
- **Coalesce rapid success notifications during bulk triage and deletion** ([#230](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/issues/230), PR [#232](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/pull/232)). Replaced the sequential success toast queue with an in-place live-updating notification (`(xN)` counter and shorter `2200 ms` timeout) and suppressed redundant per-file success toasts inside `deleteFiles()` so rapid acknowledgements or multi-file deletions never stack stale notifications down the right side of the screen, while keeping error notifications queued so failures remain visible
- **German (`de` and `de_DE`) translations for Empty Folders cleanup and duplicate nouns**. Added German translations for all new `Empty Folders` actions and dialogs and restored German noun translations (`Duplikat`, `Duplikatgruppe`, `Duplikatdetails`, `Du bist bereit!`) after automated Transifex sync
